corrections: The earlier aperture interpretation of the four small hearts is incorrect. Colouring or printing on a sheet is not a change in paper identity.
The raw RGB-classified target deliberately includes red ink. Fitting it as a two-paper weave is an artwork reinterpretation, not recovery of this photograph’s published cutting template.
The neural mask still visibly narrows checker cells, but neither its total red coverage nor the RGB appearance-mask error is sufficient evidence of physical paper-identity accuracy.
The geometric neck analysis is valid for the attempted appearance reconstruction; it does not establish a failure to recover a known woven heart motif.

Existing partial material polygons explicitly omit the little hearts. No known supervised pixels in those motifs are contradicted by this discovery, but descriptions calling them apertures need correction.
Keep the image as a genuine photographed decorated woven heart; distinguish printed-paper identity supervision from appearance segmentation.
